meta.note: First system: placeholder theme plus the AFA paper record's section bands. Status colours follow spec §12–13.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the sign-off basket bar and dialogs.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on surface, surface-raised and brand-tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: dates, reviewer names, helper text. 7:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between list rows. Decorative only; never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders. At least 3:1 on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The record red: top-level section bands, primary buttons, the app bar. Text on it uses brand-ink.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Sub-section bands in a competency list (e.g. 4.1 Airway management). Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px outside the control.

tokens.name: status-current-bg
tokens.usage: Current chip fill. Always paired with the label and a check icon.

tokens.name: status-current-fg
tokens.usage: Current chip text and icon, on status-current-bg.

tokens.name: status-expired-bg
tokens.usage: Expired chip fill (recertification lapsed).

tokens.name: status-expired-fg
tokens.usage: Expired chip text and icon, on status-expired-bg.

tokens.name: status-not-competent-bg
tokens.usage: Not Current – Not Competent chip: a solid fill, so it differs from every other status by lightness, not hue alone.

tokens.name: status-not-competent-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icon on status-not-competent-bg.

tokens.name: status-pending-bg
tokens.usage: Pending Confirmation chip fill: a supervisor has not yet confirmed.

tokens.name: status-pending-fg
tokens.usage: Pending chip text and icon, on status-pending-bg.

tokens.name: status-not-certified-bg
tokens.usage: Not Certified chip fill: never reviewed, or invalidated by a breaking revision.

tokens.name: status-not-certified-fg
tokens.usage: Not Certified chip text and icon.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per screen: the list or page name.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Top-level section band text (3 Management of injured or ill patients).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Competency titles, descriptions, form fields. 16px keeps iOS from zooming inputs.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary lines: reviewer, method, helper text.
styles.sample: Signed off by Ines Instructor · Instructor

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase column and chip labels (DATE, INITIALS, CURRENT).

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Competency codes (4.3.1, 9.1a). Fixed width keeps codes aligned down a list.

styles.name: date
styles.usage: Sign-off and expiry dates, ISO order (2026-10-04), tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between stacked lines in a row; chip padding block.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: List-row padding block; chip padding inline.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter on phones; card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections on a page; page gutter from 600px.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top of page to first heading on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Section bands, inputs, table cells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, buttons, dialogs, the basket bar.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status chips and the basket count badge.
